description: This file implements serialization, deserialization, and utility functions for 'capsule' data structures used in the quiche library, including capsule type conversions, string representations, parsing, and serialization logic for various capsule types related to WebTransport and IP address management.

classes.name: Capsule
classes.description: Represents different types of capsules used in the quiche protocol, with static methods for creation and operator overloads for comparison and string output.

classes.name: DatagramCapsule
classes.description: Represents a datagram capsule with payload data.

classes.name: LegacyDatagramCapsule
classes.description: Represents a legacy datagram capsule with payload data.

classes.name: LegacyDatagramWithoutContextCapsule
classes.description: Represents a legacy datagram capsule without context with payload data.

classes.name: CloseWebTransportSessionCapsule
classes.description: Represents a capsule to close a WebTransport session with error code and message.

classes.name: AddressRequestCapsule
classes.description: Contains requested IP address prefixes for address request capsules.

classes.name: AddressAssignCapsule
classes.description: Contains assigned IP address prefixes for address assign capsules.

classes.name: RouteAdvertisementCapsule
classes.description: Contains IP address ranges for route advertisement capsules.

classes.name: UnknownCapsule
classes.description: Represents an unknown capsule type with raw payload.

classes.name: WebTransportStreamDataCapsule
classes.description: Represents a WebTransport stream data capsule with stream ID, data, and fin flag.

classes.name: WebTransportResetStreamCapsule
classes.description: Represents a WebTransport reset stream capsule with stream ID and error code.

classes.name: WebTransportStopSendingCapsule
classes.description: Represents a WebTransport stop sending capsule with stream ID and error code.

classes.name: WebTransportMaxStreamDataCapsule
classes.description: Represents a WebTransport max stream data capsule with stream ID and max stream data.

classes.name: WebTransportMaxStreamsCapsule
classes.description: Represents a WebTransport max streams capsule with stream type and count.

methods.name: CapsuleTypeToString
methods.description: Converts a CapsuleType enum to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<< (CapsuleType)
methods.description: Outputs the string representation of a CapsuleType to an ostream.

methods.name: Capsule::Datagram
methods.description: Creates a datagram capsule with payload.

methods.name: Capsule::LegacyDatagram
methods.description: Creates a legacy datagram capsule with payload.

methods.name: Capsule::LegacyDatagramWithoutContext
methods.description: Creates a legacy datagram capsule without context with payload.

methods.name: Capsule::CloseWebTransportSession
methods.description: Creates a capsule to close a WebTransport session with error code and message.

methods.name: Capsule::Unknown
methods.description: Creates an unknown capsule with type and payload.

methods.name: Capsule::ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the capsule.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::CapsuleParser
methods.description: Constructor for CapsuleParser, takes a Visitor pointer.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::IngestCapsuleFragment
methods.description: Ingests a fragment of capsule data, attempts to parse complete capsules.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::AttemptParseCapsule
methods.description: Attempts to parse a capsule from buffered data.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::ReportParseFailure
methods.description: Reports a parse failure to the visitor.

methods.name: CapsuleParser::ErrorIfThereIsRemainingBufferedData
methods.description: Checks for remaining buffered data and reports incomplete capsule if any.

methods.name: ReadWebTransportStreamId
methods.description: Reads a WebTransport stream ID from a data reader.

methods.name: ParseCapsulePayload
methods.description: Parses capsule payload based on capsule type.
